title: French Toast with Berries and Maple Syrup
summary: Golden, custardy slices of French toast served with juicy berries and maple syrup. It’s a classic comforting breakfast that feels quick but special.
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk and vanilla extract together in a shallow bowl until smooth.
Trim the strawberries if needed and mix them with the blueberries in a bowl.
Dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, letting it soak for a few seconds on each side.
Melt the butter in a frying pan over medium heat, then cook the soaked bread for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve the French toast hot with the berries spooned over the top and maple syrup drizzled over the finished plates.
